facts.text: Kent Narrows sits at 38°58′09″N 76°14′25″W, a spot where the Chesapeake Bay meets the Kent County shoreline.
Every spring, the Kent Narrows Crab Feast draws locals to taste fresh Maryland hard crabs and oysters right on the waterfront.
Watermen and recreational boaters share the broad rivers, back bays, and scenic coves of Kent Narrows, home to crabs, oysters, osprey, herons, and sea ducks.
Marina enthusiasts can dock at Anglers Marina, Piney Narrows Yacht Haven, The Kent Narrows Boatel, Safe Harbor Narrows Point, Cedar Point, or Wells Cove.
The Kent Narrows Waterfront hosts four hotels, offering over 500 rooms for visitors who want to stay close to the bay.
Foggy dawns and striking sunsets over the Chesapeake Bay make Kent Narrows a favorite spot for photographers and sunset lovers alike.
